moments.title: The realization — being a disciplined investor pays off more than you imagined
moments.summary: Asked for the moment that struck her, a participant in the group names the time value idea: that being a disciplined investor gives benefits she could not previously have imagined.
moments.evidence: I think the time value you know being a disciplined investor will always give you good benefits which you couldn't imagine previously.

moments.title: The retirement and education calculators were the shock
moments.summary: A participant says what shocked her was the app showing how much she should be investing now versus what she will need later; the facilitator confirms she means the retirement calculator and the education calculator.
moments.evidence: The app was showing us how much you should invest now and then how much you have to play in the money. So that shocked me.

moments.title: CAGR and XIRR — now they can read their own statement
moments.summary: Asked for a new concept that will be useful, a participant names CAGR and XIRR, and says they can now understand their statement better.
moments.evidence: Now looking at that CAGR, looking at XIRR. Now we can understand the statement better.

moments.title: Compartmentalizing money — an education fund, and a travel fund for after retirement
moments.summary: Asked what she would do differently, a participant describes splitting her money into separate pots so that paying for education does not eat into anything else, including an income set aside for travel after her steady income stops.
moments.evidence: I want to compartmentalize it like an education fund. Like in my head I will want to put in this much for the expense. I want to put in this much for my travel expense after I retire.

moments.title: She is going home to start a SIP today because it takes so little money
moments.summary: A younger participant says she is going home to set up SIPs right away, because you do not need much money to start one and she can test it and see what happens.
moments.evidence: I'm so into the SIPs, I was like I'm going to go home and do this thing right now. Because you don't need so much money to put it into SIPs.
search_terms: you don't need so much money

moments.title: She only just realised her own SIPs debit every Monday
moments.summary: Another participant says she recently worked out that her SIPs have been going out every Monday without her being aware of it, and now reads the message when it arrives.
moments.evidence: So for me the SIPs have been happening every Monday. Which I was not aware of. And now when I get the message and I read it I'm like oh yeah.

moments.title: Take me with you to the next meeting with the PMS person
moments.summary: Asked what conversation she had at home after the workshop, a participant says she asked to be taken along to the next meeting with the PMS person, and is glad she now knows enough not to sit there lost.
moments.evidence: Take me with you to the next meeting with the PMS person. I'm glad I could say that. And I'm glad that I know I'll not be a dumpo sitting there.

moments.title: The conversation they had never had — sitting down together to set goals
moments.summary: A participant says the change at home has been sitting together and working out what their goals actually are for their children's education and their retirement, a conversation they had never really had.
moments.evidence: I think for us it's been sitting together and maybe focusing on what our goals are. Because we've not really had that conversation is what is this that we want. You know for our kids education, for our retirement.

moments.title: We know we have health insurance, but not what it covers
moments.summary: The group agrees they know they hold health insurance but not what they signed for, how much cover it carries or whether it is a family policy, and say they are becoming more informed about what they own.
moments.evidence: Understanding what is our health insurance? What have we signed that for? You know you don't know. I just know I have health insurance.
